summary: ON Semiconductor filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $1.5 billion private offering of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including full exercise of a $200 million initial purchasers' option. Net proceeds were approximately $1,472.9 million after discounts and expenses. The company used $70.7 million of net proceeds to pay for convertible note hedges (partially offset by warrant proceeds), $331.9 million to repurchase ~3.1 million shares of common stock concurrently with the pricing in privately negotiated transactions, and intends to use the remainder for general corporate purposes including debt repayment. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The transaction combines debt issuance with a share repurchase, effectively returning capital to shareholders. The 0% coupon and conversion feature provide favorable financing. Watch the impact on diluted shares and any subsequent hedging adjustments.
